section.title: Activity
section.para: A tennis ball was dropped from a certain height. It bounced several times, rolled along for a short period, and then stopped. Function \(H\) gives its height over time.
Here is a partial graph of \(H\). Height is measured in feet. Time is measured in seconds.
Use the graph to help you answer the questions.
Be prepared to explain what each value or set of values means in this situation.

div.para: \(H(0)=6\). It tells us the ball was dropped from a height of 6 feet at \(t=0\).

list.item: Find \(H(0)\). What point is this on the graph? What does it represent?

div.para: \(x=0.54\), \(x=1.48\), and \(x=2.25\) are three possible solutions, but there are others. Each one represents the time when the ball hit the ground.
The domain includes all values between 0 and the time when the ball stopped moving, which, based on the graph, is about 3.8.

list.item: Describe the domain of the function.

div.para: The range includes all values between 0 and 6 feet, the height from which the ball was dropped.

list.item: Describe the range of the function.

problem.title: Extending Your Thinking
problem.para: In function \(H\), the input was time in seconds, and the output was height in feet.
Think about some other quantities that could be inputs or outputs in this situation.

list.item: Describe a function whose domain includes only integers. Be sure to specify the units.
Sketch a graph of this function. Write down your answer then select the solution button to compare your answer.
